heading: Rhode Island
lead: Rhode Island constitutes one judicial district. Court shall be held at Providence.

notes.text: Historical and Revision NotesBased on title 28, U.S.C., 1940 ed., § 185 (Mar. 3, 1911, ch. 231, § 104, 36 Stat. 1123; Feb. 1, 1912, ch. 27, 37 Stat. 59). Changes in phraseology were made.
